courses.title: One to One Somatic Coaching: Journey to Somatic Liberation
courses.description: Private one-to-one sessions for women moving through the hormonal shifts of midlife who want to meet this season as a time of renewal rather than decline. Kristi combines coaching with somatic embodied yoga, yoga nidra and energy work, with attention to intuition, self-love and relationships. Sessions begin with a discovery call.

flags: Health check: the page (https://www.kristikuttner.com/somatic, read 12 Nov 2026) frames the coaching around hormonal changes (menopause) in spiritual and emotional terms: intuition, self-love, sensuality, divine feminine energy. It makes no claim to treat a condition and says nothing about medication or medical care, so restored under the 12 Nov rule. A human may want a look given the midlife-hormones framing.
